decisions.reason: Persistent own-page presentation signals that the option remains valuable and cheap to keep.
Its premium hand-knotted positioning and continued dedicated page suggest the firm still sees option value and acceptable cost.
Having lost its own page and surviving only as a brief mention, its weak results make abandonment more likely.
The low-pile carpet remains on its own page with no negative signal, so it is a low-cost option worth keeping.
The swivel chair line's multiple models and steady dedicated page indicate sufficient option value to keep.
